analysis.summary: The City of Northbridge is inviting tenders for the supply, installation, and maintenance of smart LED street lighting across the Eastgate and Riverside districts under tender NB-2026-114.

requirements.description: Tenderers must hold a valid electrical contractor licence issued by the State Electrical Safety Board.

evidence.excerpt: Tenderers must hold a valid electrical contractor licence issued by the State Electrical Safety Board.

requirements.description: Demonstrate at least three completed street lighting projects of comparable scope within the last five years.

evidence.excerpt: Tenderers shall demonstrate at least three (3) completed street lighting projects of comparable scope within the last five years.

requirements.description: Provide audited financial statements for the last two financial years.

evidence.excerpt: The tenderer must provide audited financial statements for the last two financial years.

requirements.description: Minimum annual turnover of 2.5 million is required.

evidence.excerpt: Minimum annual turnover of 2.5 million is required.

requirements.description: Provide a traffic management plan prior to any works on arterial roads.

evidence.excerpt: The contractor shall provide a traffic management plan prior to any works on arterial roads.

requirements.description: Luminaires shall be warranted for a minimum of 10 years.

evidence.excerpt: Warranty: luminaires shall be warranted for a minimum of 10 years.

requirements.description: Attend a mandatory site briefing held on 8 January 2027.

evidence.excerpt: A mandatory site briefing will be held on 8 January 2027.

requirements.description: Submit a completed Schedule of Rates (Form F-3).

evidence.excerpt: Tenderers shall submit a completed Schedule of Rates (Form F-3).

requirements.description: Include proof of public liability insurance of not less than 10 million.

evidence.excerpt: Proof of public liability insurance of not less than 10 million must be included.

requirements.description: Provide performance security equal to 5% of the contract value upon award.

evidence.excerpt: Performance security equal to 5% of the contract value is required upon award.

deadlines.relatedRequirement: Clarification questions must be submitted by 12 January 2027, 17:00 local time.

evidence.excerpt: Clarification questions must be submitted by 12 January 2027, 17:00 local time.

deadlines.relatedRequirement: A mandatory site briefing will be held on 8 January 2027.

evidence.excerpt: A mandatory site briefing will be held on 8 January 2027.

deadlines.relatedRequirement: Tender closing date: 2 February 2027 at 14:00 local time.

evidence.excerpt: Tender closing date: 2 February 2027 at 14:00 local time.

deadlines.description: Installation deadline for the first 400 luminaires
deadlines.relatedRequirement: Installation of the first 400 luminaires must be completed within 90 days of contract award.

evidence.excerpt: Installation of the first 400 luminaires must be completed within 90 days of contract award.

deadlines.relatedRequirement: Full installation shall be completed no later than 30 June 2027.

evidence.excerpt: Full installation shall be completed no later than 30 June 2027.

specifications.details: Rated between 40W and 120W, minimum efficacy of 150 lumens per watt, IP66 ingress protection rating, colour temperature not exceeding 3000K in residential zones

evidence.excerpt: Supply of 1,250 LED luminaires rated between 40W and 120W.

specifications.details: Compatible with the City's central management system, comply with the City's data protection policy

evidence.excerpt: Supply of 1,250 networked lighting control nodes compatible with the City's central management system.

specifications.details: 8 m height in the Riverside district

evidence.excerpt: Supply of 40 replacement poles of 8 m height in the Riverside district.

risks.title: Estimated Contract Value Unconfirmed
risks.explanation: The estimated contract value is to be confirmed by the Finance Committee, which introduces financial uncertainty during tender preparation.

evidence.excerpt: Estimated contract value: to be confirmed by the Finance Committee.

missing: Annex D conditions regarding joint ventures
